title: To the Stars material testing with military labs halted by COVID
summary: Peter Levenda tells of To the Stars material testing with military labs halted by COVID, about c. 2019–2020 at To the Stars Academy / US military laboratories, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: To the Stars Academy / US military laboratories

tellings.quote: We know that we were getting close to something. We were developing relationships with the military with their laboratories >> to do the kind of testing only they could do. >> And then COVID hit. >> When COVID hit, all the relationship with the military really stopped.

plain: A writer named Peter Levenda, billed on a podcast as a CIA historian, told the host Jesse Michels about his time with To the Stars Academy, a private group set up to look into UFOs. He says that around 2019 the group was building ties with US military laboratories to run tests on materials that only those labs could do, and that they felt they were getting close to something. Then, he says, the COVID pandemic hit and the relationship with the military stopped, which matters to him because it would mean serious study of strange materials was cut off just as it began.
